tasks.title: [BUG] createTreeAssociation fails for admin users due to missing company_id

tasks.title: [BUG] Table Visualizer dataset loading fails for all users due to storage RLS mismatch
tasks.description:

tasks.title: [BUG] Fix auth loading state causing full-page remount on token refresh
tasks.description:
Symptom: When switching browser tabs or when Supabase refreshes the auth token, the entire app shows a full-screen spinner and all page state is lost (selected items, form inputs, scroll position).

Expected: Token refreshes should happen silently in the background without remounting the app or losing state.

Root Cause: In src/lib/auth/context.tsx, the syncAuthState function calls setLoading(true) at line 68 on EVERY auth state change event, including silent token refreshes. This causes RoleGuard to render the loading spinner, which unmounts the entire page content.

Fix Approach: Track whether the initial auth check is complete separately from the loading state. Only show the loading spinner during the initial session fetch. Subsequent auth state changes (token refreshes) should update session/profile silently without setting loading=true.

Files Affected: src/lib/auth/context.tsx

Reproduction:
1. Log in to the app
2. Navigate to any page with state (e.g., dataset detail with a tab selected)
3. Switch to another browser tab and wait ~5 minutes
4. Switch back - the page reloads and selected tab is lost
tasks.author: OpenCode
tasks.implementation_notes:
FIXED: Added isInitialCheckCompleteRef to track whether the initial auth check has completed. Modified syncAuthState to accept an isInitial parameter. Only sets loading=true during the initial auth check (from getSession). Subsequent auth state changes (token refreshes, sign-outs) update session/profile silently without triggering the loading spinner.

Files modified:
- src/lib/auth/context.tsx

Tests added:

tasks.title: [BUG] Fix TabsContent unmounting inactive tabs causing state loss
tasks.description:
Symptom: When switching between tabs in the UI (e.g., on dataset detail page), the previously active tab content is completely unmounted. When switching back, all state within that tab is lost - data refetches, scroll position resets, and any selections are cleared.

Expected: Switching tabs should preserve the state of inactive tabs. The content should remain mounted but hidden.

Root Cause: In src/components/ui/tabs.tsx at line 80, TabsContent returns null when the tab is not active. This causes React to fully unmount the tab content and all its children.

Fix Approach: Change TabsContent to always render its children but apply a hidden class when inactive. This keeps the component tree mounted while visually hiding inactive tabs.

Files Affected: src/components/ui/tabs.tsx

Reproduction:
1. Go to a dataset detail page
2. Switch to Data Grid tab
3. Scroll down or interact with the grid
4. Switch to Schema Map tab
5. Switch back to Data Grid - the grid reloads and scroll position is lost
tasks.author: OpenCode
tasks.implementation_notes:
FIXED: Changed TabsContent from returning null for inactive tabs to always rendering children with a hidden CSS class when inactive. This preserves React component state across tab switches.

tasks.title: [BUG] Tree visualizer deep nodes overlap
tasks.description:
Symptom: In the tree visualizer, a single tree deeper than two levels causes decision nodes and leaf nodes to overlap horizontally.

Expected: Deeper levels should preserve at least the same horizontal spacing used by two-level trees so nodes remain readable.

Root Cause: src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.ts used a fixed 800px layout span and recursively halved it at every depth. Level 3 collapsed adjacent nodes to 100px spacing and level 4 to 50px, below the 160px decision-node minimum width.

Fix Approach: Replace exponential fixed-span halving with a leaf-slot layout: each leaf receives a fixed horizontal slot, and each decision node is centered over its child subtree. Use computed tree dimensions when placing multiple trees to avoid ensemble overlap.

Files Affected:
- src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.ts
- src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.test.ts

Reproduction:
1. Open a tree with at least three branch levels in /tree-visualizer/:treeId
2. Observe descendants overlap/collapse horizontally
3. Compare level-3+ spacing with the two-level layout spacing
tasks.author: Codex
tasks.implementation_notes:
Implemented compact contour packing for the tree visualizer layout.

Original fix: replaced exponential fixed-span halving with deep-safe spacing.
Review feedback: fixed leaf-slot layout made sparse deep trees too wide; sibling sides do not need equal global spacing, only an apparent edge gap between visible subtree contours.
Response: replaced equal leaf-slot positioning with contour-based subtree packing. Each subtree is laid out independently, the right subtree shifts only enough to clear the left subtree's visible right edge at overlapping levels, and node widths are estimated from rendered labels. Multi-tree ensemble offsets now use computed rendered bounds instead of leaf-count cell widths.

Files modified:
- src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.ts
- src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.test.ts

Verification:
- npx vitest run src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.test.ts
- npx eslint src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.ts src/lib/utils/treeToReactFlow.test.ts
- npm run build
